most_likely.statement: Chain routing: the autocompute sequence-search step submits the antibody heavy chain (B) as the BLAST query and never submits the antigen chain (A).
most_likely.confidence: high for the observed run (directly evidenced that only B was searched); the routing rule itself is inferred, because the service code is not readable here.
supporting: sequence_info.fasta assigns B as heavy_sequence and leaves light_sequence empty
the single query in the blast JSON is B
the autocompute payload contains no chain selector, so role assignment happens inside the service
most_likely.tension: The UI wording the user reports ('Searched by antigen sequence similarity') describes an antigen query, which contradicts the executed query set.

most_likely.statement: Because the homology annotation is assembled from antigen-oriented search results, a B-only search leaves annotations.homology empty.
supporting: the UI wording ties the field to the antigen
the field is empty while a large B-chain result set exists
uniprot and pdb annotations are empty at the same time, which points at an annotation stage that produced nothing rather than at a filtering step on one hit list

most_likely.statement: Alternative: MMetrics assembles annotations.homology only from non-immunoglobulin hits and/or from model_tasks.results, both of which are empty here.
most_likely.confidence: medium; not distinguishable from M2 with available evidence
supporting: all 500 hits are immunoglobulin-family, so any immunoglobulin-depleting filter would return zero
the record's own description says 'no homology or UniProt annotations were available'

why_the_null_result_is_suspicious.statement: A genuine chain-A query against PDB would be expected to return PD-L1 structures, so an empty antigen-homology field is more consistent with 'the antigen was never queried (or its result was never ingested)' than with 'the antigen was searched and nothing was found'.
why_the_null_result_is_suspicious.status: domain-knowledge inference only; NOT measured in this session because running the A-chain search would require a new task, which the user forbade.
why_the_null_result_is_suspicious.counterpoint: The B search itself hit the 500-hit cap (max_seq default 500, exactly 500 unique hits) with a permissive E-value ceiling, so the search configuration is permissive, not restrictive.
